page.overview:
Who is Furosa?

If asks for drink recommendations, tells him about their featured cocktail, the . She describes the taste of the as a light, sweet and cool sensation and that it is like drinking "distilled motivation." When asked if they serve , is appalled by the idea of serving something so childish. She then complains, thinking that sent to say that as a prank and criticizes the for only drawing young people's attention.

When ends the conversation, comments that she has not seen in a while, explaining that she used to come to every day to drink a . cuts herself off and apologizes after realizing that there is no reason to talk to about this.

During "" , can try to order a from . However, she needs a huge amount of ice to make the drink and she is all out. In addition, due to its strength, she refuses to sell it to . After informs her that it is for , she laments that she can not carry the from the .

Upon arriving to the , gets permission from to take some once she finds out it is for . After this, the will begin. must now carry the block of to , who is waiting for past the ruins south of the .
